title: Technology Analyst
description:
About the Role Technology Analyst (IMP NOTE - This is not a Business Analyst or Data Analyst Role)  Introduction

Oxford University Press is seeking an Analyst, DPM to support the development, enhancement, and delivery of innovative digital products that help advance learning and educational outcomes. This is an excellent opportunity for a technology-focused professional who is passionate about digital product development and enjoys working in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.

As part of the Digital Product Management team, you will play an important role in supporting the development, customization, release, and maintenance of digital products. You will work closely with colleagues across Editorial, Marketing, Customer Services, and external technology partners, helping to deliver high-quality digital solutions that support OUP's mission of advancing knowledge and learning.

The role offers exposure to product management, agile delivery, digital content management, quality assurance, customer-focused product enhancements, and educational technology. It is ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, building innovative solutions, and contributing to the ongoing growth of digital learning products.

  Opportunity

As Analyst, DPM, you will support the delivery of digital products throughout their lifecycle, ensuring high-quality user experiences and timely product releases.

Key responsibilities include:

* Supporting the development of new products, product features, and innovative ideas, including building quick MVPs to help stakeholders visualize product concepts.
* Developing feature backlogs and user stories, agreeing priorities with stakeholders, and supporting agile delivery of product enhancements within agreed timelines.
* Managing the sourcing, ingestion, and delivery of learning content for digital products.
* Enhancing digital content by enabling engaging digital interactions and learning experiences.
* Liaising with internal and external stakeholders to ensure quality, accuracy, and timely delivery of product releases.
* Supporting product development processes and ensuring adherence to quality standards.
* Coordinating Quality Assurance (QA) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities to ensure products meet performance and security requirements.
* Supporting the timely delivery of school updates, patches, installers, and software releases, including planning, testing, release note validation, and communication activities.
* Delivering product training sessions for Customer Services, Marketing, and other internal teams as required.
* Ensuring User Manuals, FAQs, Help Videos, and related support materials are maintained, updated, and of a high standard.
* Ensuring compliance requirements, NDA obligations, and third-party processes are followed in accordance with group guidelines.
* Coordinating effectively with Editorial, Marketing, Customer Support, Finance teams, and third-party vendor partners.

  Impact

This role is critical in ensuring OUP's digital products are delivered efficiently, maintained to high standards, and continually improved to meet customer needs. By supporting product development, content delivery, quality assurance, and stakeholder collaboration, you will help drive successful product launches, improved customer experiences, and operational excellence across OUP's digital portfolio.

  About You Essential Criteria

* B.Tech or MCA in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3-4 years of IT experience.
* At least 1 year of experience in product development, product management, or project delivery roles.
* Experience in digital product creation, development, implementation, and execution.
* Experience working within the EdTech, K-12, or Publishing domain.
* Experience supporting cloud-enabled and web-enabled solutions, including web and app-based products.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Proven ability to coordinate with third-party suppliers and delivery partners.
* Self-motivated, creative, dedicated, and able to work independently.
* High level of integrity and ownership.

Desirable Criteria

* Experience working within agile product development environments.
* Exposure to QA, UAT, release management, and product lifecycle management.
* Experience managing customer-facing digital products and implementations.
* Understanding of digital content workflows and learning technologies.
* Experience developing product documentation, training materials, and support resources.
* Knowledge of educational publishing and digital learning solutions.

  Queries

Please contact 
**shariq.anwar@oup.com**
with any queries relating to this role. To ensure a smooth application process, please submit your CV through this link than via email.

title: Lead- Data Quality & Governance
description:
**OUR STORY**
**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**
**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**
**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**
**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**
**Role Overview**
STMicroelectronics is seeking a highly organized and proactive Data Governance & Quality Lead to drive enterprise-wide data quality, governance, and process documentation initiatives across People Function.
  
  
This role will be responsible for establishing and maintaining data governance frameworks, standardizing master and transactional data across regions and systems, defining data ownership and maintenance policies, and implementing robust data quality controls. In parallel, the role will ensure that global policies, procedures, and standard operating processes (SOPs) remain accurate, current, and aligned with evolving business requirements.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong project management capabilities with process excellence, stakeholder management, and data governance expertise to enable operational efficiency, compliance, and future-ready self-service capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and implement enterprise-wide data governance standards and frameworks for People Function
* Establish data ownership, stewardship, and accountability models across teams.
* Drive harmonization and standardization of master and operational data across regions and systems.
* Process Documentation & Knowledge Governance
* Develop and maintain data dictionaries, business rules, and data standards.
* Define data creation, modification, approval, and maintenance processes.
* Implement data quality monitoring mechanisms, KPIs, dashboards, and periodic audits.
* Identify data quality gaps and lead remediation initiatives with business and Digital Transformation & IT stakeholders.
* Ensure consistency and integrity of critical business data throughout its lifecycle.
* Partner with system owners and digital teams to embed governance controls into business applications and workflows.
* Own the governance framework for global policies, SOPs, work instructions, and process documentation.
* Ensure documentation remains current, accurate, compliant, and aligned with operational practices.
* Define review cycles, approval workflows, and document control standards.
* Drive continuous improvement of process documentation quality and usability.
* Establish standards for structured knowledge management and process repositories.
* Collaborate with process owners to simplify, standardize, and optimize documentation.
* Future-Ready Knowledge & Self-Service Enablement
* Develop frameworks that make policies and procedures easily searchable, consumable, and reusable.
* Ensure process documentation is structured to support digital self-service platforms, AI-enabled knowledge systems, and agent-assist capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and knowledge management technologies to improve user experience and operational effectiveness.
* Support the transformation toward self-service and intelligent support models.
* Project & Stakeholder Management
* Lead cross-functional governance and process improvement initiatives.
* Develop project plans, governance forums, milestones, and implementation roadmaps.
* Facilitate alignment among global stakeholders, regional teams, business owners, and IT organizations.
* Track progress, risks, dependencies, and outcomes across multiple initiatives.
* Provide regular reporting and executive-level updates on governance maturity, data quality, and documentation health.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.
* 15+ years of experience in Data Governance, Business Process Management, Shared Services, Operations Excellence, or related areas.
* Proven experience managing cross-functional projects in global organizations.
* Strong understanding of data quality management, governance frameworks, and process standardization.
* Experience defining policies, controls, workflows, and governance models.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Shared Services, Global Business Services (GBS) organizations.
* Knowledge of ERP and enterprise platforms such as SAP, ServiceNow, Oracle, People Soft, Workday, or similar systems.
* Experience with knowledge management platforms and self-service solutions.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled knowledge management and digital transformation initiatives.
* Certification in Project Management, Lean Six Sigma, Data Governance, or Process Excellence is a plus.

**Success Measures**

* Improvement in data quality KPIs and governance compliance.
* Reduction in data inconsistencies across systems and regions.
* Percentage of policies and SOPs reviewed and updated on time.
* Increased adoption of standardized processes and governance controls.
* Enhanced self-service effectiveness and knowledge base usability.
* Successful delivery of governance and process improvement projects.

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.
  
  
At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.
  
  
To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

title: Staff/ Sr Staff DFT Solutions Engineer
description:
We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.You Are
  
  
You are
  
  
You have spent years deep in the details of digital IC design, and you know that the difference between a chip that works and one that doesn't often comes down to decisions made during DFT planning. You are the engineer who catches those decisions early, who can look at a scan architecture and immediately see where the coverage gaps will show up three months later during silicon bring-up. You have debugged enough ATPG failures and MBIST issues to know that the best solutions start with understanding what the customer is actually trying to build, not just what they think they need.
  
  
You operate at the intersection of deep technical work and customer collaboration. You can spend the morning implementing a complex test access network for a multi-IP SoC and the afternoon explaining to a customer why their current flow is leaving test coverage on the table, and you are equally comfortable in both modes. You do not wait for perfect specs. You ask the right questions, prototype quickly, and iterate based on what you learn.
  
  
At Synopsys, you will work with customers designing some of the most complex chips in automotive, AI, and consumer electronics, and what you deliver will directly determine whether their silicon works on the first spin.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Deliver end-to-end DFT solutions for customer designs, from architecture planning and scan insertion through pattern generation, silicon bring-up, and diagnostics analysis
* Implement and validate test solutions including scan, MBIST, and IEEE 1687 architectures for complex SoCs with multiple IP blocks
* Participate in customer design reviews to understand their flows, identify gaps, and propose specific improvements that reduce test time or increase coverage
* Prototype and validate new DFT methodologies in collaboration with Solution Architects, proving out viability before customer deployment
* Provide technical support and training to customers, including hands-on problem resolution, methodology workshops, and account-level engagement
* Conduct product demonstrations, competitive benchmarking, and evaluations to help win new customers and expand adoption of Synopsys test solutions
* Analyze silicon test data, diagnose failures, and present findings to both internal teams and customer stakeholders with clear recommendations

The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Enable first-time silicon success for customers by delivering robust, validated DFT solutions that catch issues before tapeout
* Accelerate time-to-market for automotive and consumer electronics customers by optimizing their test flows and reducing pattern generation cycles
* Expand Synopsys' footprint in next-generation test technologies by proving out new methodologies that become standard practice across accounts
* Build long-term customer relationships that turn one-time engagements into strategic partnerships, increasing account value and retention
* Raise the technical capability of customer teams through training and knowledge transfer, creating a multiplier effect beyond individual projects
* Shape the direction of Synopsys test products by feeding real-world customer challenges and use cases back to R&D teams
* Contribute to measurable improvements in test coverage, pattern count reduction, and silicon yield across diverse customer programs

What You'll Need
  
  

* Bachelor's degree with 7+ years or Master's degree with 5+ years in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
* Hands-on experience with RTL coding, DFT insertion, ATPG pattern generation, and silicon bring-up for digital ICs
* Deep knowledge of scan architectures, fault models, test access networks, and IEEE standards including 1149.1, 1500, and 1687
* Proven ability to handle scan implementation and validation for large, multi-IP SoCs with complex hierarchies and multiple clock domains
* Experience with MBIST concepts, architecture planning, and integration in automotive or safety-critical design environments is a strong plus
* Familiarity with industry-standard DFT tools and flows, exposure to Synopsys TetraMAX, DFT Compiler, or MBIST Architect is valuable
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to translate technical concepts for both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders

Who You Are
  
  

* You can walk into a customer design review, absorb their methodology in real time, and walk out with three specific recommendations they can act on next week
* You are comfortable working independently on complex technical problems while knowing when to pull in a Solution Architect or R&D engineer for a second opinion
* You manage multiple customer engagements at once without dropping threads, keeping track of where each project stands and what needs to happen next
* You prototype quickly and iterate based on feedback, treating customer pushback as useful signal rather than friction
* You explain tradeoffs clearly, whether you are talking to a junior engineer learning DFT or a VP trying to understand why test time matters for their product schedule
* You stay current on emerging test standards and methodologies because you are genuinely curious about where the technology is headed, not just what you need to know today

title: Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join Marsh People & Investment at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Noida/Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.
  
  
As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.
  
  
You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.
* Collaborate with the Pod Leadership, Product Owner, and stakeholders to create Persona’s, Story Maps, and a Release Plan for the project.
* Work in partnership with the Product Owner and agile teams in the creation and maintenance of Product Backlog Items ensuring that Epics and User Stories are continuously prioritized and aligned to the Product Roadmap and MVP.
* Facilitate refinement sessions with the Agile Teams and Business to sufficiently detail out User Stories, to include dependencies.
* Facilitate the Sprint Review ceremony by working with the agile teams, Product Owner, Business and Customer to review, assess and adapt the latest product increment by incorporating customer insights and feedback into the Product Backlog.
* Actively work with Pod Leadership by running assessments processes for the POD and provide constructive feedback towards continuously improving the Systems Analyst function, standards and processes in Global Technology.
* Lead workshops and work collaboratively with data engineers, data architects, technical experts, and AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into a POD.
* Demonstrate an awareness of MMC and Mercer Technical, Security and Process Standards and work with the team to incorporate them in product delivery through the software development life cycle.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.
* Capability to work within a POD/ cross-functional squads to develop and implement an AI strategy that aligns with business needs.
* Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously improve AI capabilities within the organization.
* An Agile Mindset with an in-depth understanding of Agile Principles.
* Must have prior experience as an IT Systems Analyst or IT Business Analyst working as part of an agile team using an Agile Workflow tool such as JIRA or TFS.
* Agile Certification, such as CSM, PSM, CSPO, PSPO, PMI-ACP, Certified SAFe Practitioner, Azure AI Fundamentals is desirable.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

title: Control & Protection Application Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
As a Control and protection System Application Engineer, you will report to the Control & Protection System Application Manager. The successful candidate will be part of a highly motivated and dynamic team of engineers working on the design of Control and Protection functions for LCC and VSC HVDC schemes. The development of such Control system is technically challenging and involves a variety of engineering disciplines, contribution through teamwork and an innovative approach.
  
  
As a Control Systems Application Engineer you will be expected to study on the existing designs of specified project and functionalities in MATLAB/Simulink and transfer them to the PSCAD simulation environment across the full delivery process life cycle, including but not limited to plant model design and maintenance, verification model in MATLAB, creating test harness for conversion, writing model guides, and evaluating models in PSCAD.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Essential Responsibilities**

* Support the business’ Tendering, Operations, Contractual and After Sales needs regarding:
* Defining control system requirements.
* HVDC System in electromagnetic transient tools like PSCAD, EMTP-RV etc.
* Plant modelling in various simulation tools (MATLAB, PSCAD etc) and its verification.
* Dynamic Performance Studies (DPS) and other design studies using both offline and online simulation tools
* Control and protection parameters tuning to meet grid stability criteria specified in customer technical specifications.
* Conversion of MATLAB Simulink algorithms to PSCAD models
* Support improvements to existing algorithm/strategies for power fault recovery or instability issues during DPS studies
* Contribute to development of new strategies for control, protection, and sequencing (start-up/shut down sequence) to meet customer technical specifications if required
* Proposing continual improvement activities for improving the effectiveness and efficiency of control application team through the introduction of tools, methods, and process improvements.
* Support a standard product methodology mindset, seek opportunities to re-use solutions, improve quality and reliability whilst reducing the delivery timeline and associated costs

**Qualifications / Essential Requirements**

* Engineering degree or equivalent including power systems and power electronics subjects or proven equivalent knowledge and experience in HVDC business
* Strong sense of urgency and ability to identify and manage technical risks
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, experienced in creating and presenting technical reports and responding to clients’ technical questions
* Ability to understand and communicate customer requirements, ownership of technical discussions with customers and capable of developing client relationships.
* Competent on functional characteristics of power systems and understand the interactions between AC and HVDC systems.
* Knowledge HVDC Control, Protection and Sequencing strategy
* Experience in PSCAD and MATLAB-SIMULINK simulation tools
* Able to work to deadlines under pressure whilst maintaining the safety, quality, and engineering integrity of the solution
* Must be flexible with working hours and willing to travel to support projects globally

**Desired Characteristics**

* Knowledge of Power System analysis, Power system stability
* Experienced user of power system study tools such as Power Factory, PSS/E, ETAP, EMTDC RV. Etc.
* Process improvement or RCA experience or certification
* Experienced in technical leadership
* Experience working in HVDC industry
* Ability to define requirements and ensure they adhere to best practice

**About GE Grid Solutions**
At GEV Grid Solutions we are electrifying the world with advanced grid technologies. As leaders in the energy space our goal is to accelerate the transition for a more energy efficient grid to full fill the needs of tomorrow. With a focus on growth and sustainability GEV Grid Solutions plays a pivotable role in integrating Renewables onto the grid to drive to carbon neutral. In Grid Solutions we help enable the transition for a greener more reliable Grid. GEV Grid Solutions has the most advanced and comprehensive product and solutions portfolio within the energy sector.
  
  
**Why we come to work:**
At GEV Renewable Energy, our engineers are always up for the challenge - and we’re always driven to find the best solution. Our projects are unique and interesting, and you’ll need to bring a solution-focused, positive approach to each one to do your best. Surrounded by committed, loyal colleagues, if you can dare to bring your ingenuity and desire to make an impact, you’ll be exposed to game-changing, diverse projects that truly allow you to play your part in the energy transition.

title: App Dev Engr/Scient, Inter
description:
**Overview**
Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
  
  
Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
  
  
**About The Role**
PowerArtist is a leading RTL power analysis and optimization platform widely adopted across top semiconductor and SoC companies for early power estimation and debug. With increasing industry focus on low-power design and faster tape-outs, PowerArtist plays a critical role in enabling early power closure and design efficiency.
  
  
This position offers strong customer visibility, exposure to advanced SoC programs, and the opportunity to work closely with leading semiconductor customers to drive power optimization/estimation success.
  
  
This role focuses on
**product validation**
, feature qualification, and
**Application Engineering (AE) backend support**
. You will work closely with Product Development, Application Engineering, and key semiconductor customers to validate new capabilities, reproduce and analyze customer-reported issues, develop comprehensive validation strategies, and enable rapid issue resolution. The position offers broad exposure to advanced SoC design flows, strong cross-functional collaboration, and the opportunity to directly influence product quality, customer success, and future feature development.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Validate new PowerArtist features, enhancements, and bug fixes across diverse design environments and customer use cases.
* Develop and maintain feature validation test plans, design suites.
* Perform functional, performance, and quality verification of RTL power analysis flows.
* Reproduce, analyze, and debug customer-reported issues in collaboration with R&D and AE teams.
* Create testcases to verify bug fixes and ensure no regressions are introduced.
* Validate support for new technologies, libraries, simulators, synthesis tools, and waveform formats.
* Analyze RTL power estimation results and verify accuracy against expected behavior.
* Automate validation workflows, regression execution, and result analysis using scripting.
* Provide backend technical support to AE teams by investigating complex customer issues and identifying root causes.
* Collaborate closely with R&D during feature development cycles to improve product quality and usability.
* Support release qualification activities and ensure timely delivery of high-quality product releases.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills:**

* 3+ years of experience in RTL design, verification, power analysis, or EDA tool validation.
* Strong understanding of RTL (Verilog/SystemVerilog) and digital design fundamentals.
* Familiarity with AI/ML and Generative AI technologies, including their application in EDA workflows, validation automation, regression analysis, testcase generation, and productivity enhancement.
* Hands-on experience with PowerArtist or RTL power estimation and analysis methodologies.
* Knowledge of switching activity formats (VCD, FSDB, SAIF) and power modeling concepts.
* Familiarity with dynamic power, clock power, and activity-based power estimation techniques.
* Experience debugging RTL power analysis flows, libraries, constraints, and waveform-related issues.
* Knowledge of synthesis tools (Design Compiler, Genus) and simulation environments (VCS, Xcelium, Questa).
* Strong debugging, root-cause analysis, and log investigation skills.
* Proficiency in TCL, Shell, and/or Python scripting for automation and regression development.
* Ability to work effectively with R&D and AE teams in diagnosing and resolving complex technical issues.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with an emphasis on technical documentation.

Careers Privacy Statement\*\*\*Keysight is an Equal Opportunity Employer.\*\*\*

title: AI Technology Consultant
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Staff / Senior Staff – AI-Enabled Technology Advisory**
**India**
**Role Overview**
Crowe’s Technology Advisory practice is seeking a hands-on AI-enabled technology advisory professional to join our India-based team and support U.S.-based consulting teams.
  
  
This role is designed for someone who actively works in AI tools throughout the day and enjoys building, testing, refining, and documenting better ways of working. The successful candidate will combine strong analytical skills with practical AI fluency to support client engagements and build reusable workflows for research, file analysis, synthesis, writing, presentation development, and knowledge management.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be comfortable working across tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Notion, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and Power Platform. They should be able to write and refine prompts and Claude skills, compare alternative approaches, test output quality, and improve workflows until they produce reliable, professional results.
  
  
This is not a data science, machine learning, or purely technical development role. It is a hands-on advisory and delivery role focused on improving the speed, quality, and consistency of consulting work.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Build AI-Enabled Delivery Workflows**

* Create and maintain reusable AI workflows for research, document review, file analysis, synthesis, writing, and presentation development
* Write and refine Claude skills, system instructions, prompts, custom assistants, and workflow templates
* Build structured processes for analyzing interview notes, client files, data rooms, requirements, prior deliverables, and other source materials
* Define clear inputs, outputs, validation steps, and human-review checkpoints
* Convert repeatable consulting activities into documented workflows
* Maintain and improve existing workflows as tools and models change

**Test and Refine AI Outputs**

* Compare AI tools, models, prompts, context approaches, and workflow designs
* Conduct structured A/B testing using defined evaluation criteria
* Evaluate outputs for accuracy, completeness, consistency, insight, and usability
* Document test results, version history, lessons learned, and recommended approaches
* Identify gaps, errors, unsupported conclusions, and weak analysis in AI-generated content
* Continue refining solutions rather than accepting the first usable output

**Perform Analysis and Develop Deliverables**

* Review and synthesize information from documents, spreadsheets, presentations, interview notes, and other source materials
* Identify key themes, risks, findings, inconsistencies, and implications
* Support development of clear conclusions and practical recommendations
* Create well-structured written deliverables and professional PowerPoint presentations
* Support Excel-based analysis, cost estimates, and financial models
* Validate AI-generated content against source materials before it is used
* Apply judgment to determine whether an output is accurate, clear, and decision-useful

**Build Knowledge and Content Systems**

* Organize prompts, skills, workflows, templates, evaluations, and guidance in Notion or similar platforms
* Develop structured data and knowledge systems that organize source materials, findings, and reusable content
* Support content organization across Notion, SharePoint, Teams, and Microsoft 365
* Maintain clear documentation, version history, and usage instructions
* Create quick-reference guides and supporting materials that allow others to reuse workflows

**Support Enterprise Tools and Automation**

* Explore how AI workflows can operate with SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot Studio, and related tools
* Build or support simple low-code automations and multi-tool workflows
* Use scripting, APIs, MCP, structured data, or AI-assisted coding where appropriate
* Help design processes for moving, reviewing, analyzing, and storing files
* Support approved content access, permissions, confidentiality, and governance requirements
* Coordinate with technical teams when advanced development or integration support is needed

**Support Consulting Engagements**

* Work with U.S.-based and India-based team members to understand delivery needs
* Support IT Due Diligence, IT Assessment, integration, ERP advisory, and related engagements
* Review and synthesize client data and technical materials
* Assist in building findings, recommendations, presentations, cost estimates, and other deliverables
* Independently manage defined workstreams and deliverables
* Collaborate effectively across time zones and communicate progress clearly
* Build working knowledge across areas such as enterprise applications, data and reporting, AI, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and IT operations
* Develop deeper knowledge in one or more technology domains over time

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience
* Strong hands-on experience using generative AI tools for professional work
* Demonstrated experience building and refining prompts, reusable assistants, workflows, or automations
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills
* Ability to review multiple sources and synthesize information into clear findings
* Strong written communication and PowerPoint development skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and the ability to support analysis and modeling
* Ability to execute against clear direction and independently work through open-ended problems
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
* Strong organizational, documentation, and task-management skills
* Ability to work collaboratively across time zones
* Ability to identify unsupported conclusions or quality issues in AI-generated content

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced experience with Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Notion, or similar tools
* Experience creating Claude skills, custom GPTs, project instructions, reusable agents, or prompt libraries
* Experience conducting structured A/B testing or comparing alternative workflow approaches
* Experience with SharePoint, Teams, Microsoft 365, Power Automate, Power Apps, or Copilot Studio
* Familiarity with APIs, MCP, scripting, structured data, schema design, low-code development, or AI-assisted coding
* Experience with document analysis, enterprise search, or knowledge management
* Familiarity with consulting, professional services, technology advisory, ERP, due diligence, integration, or business transformation
* Working knowledge in one or more IT domains, such as enterprise systems, data and reporting, AI, cybersecurity, infrastructure, or IT operations
* Experience supporting U.S.-based or global teams

**What Success Looks Like**
Within the first 90 days, the successful candidate will:
  
  

* Understand the practice’s core workflows, deliverables, and quality standards
* Build and document reusable AI-enabled workflows
* Create and refine prompts, Claude skills, or reusable AI instructions
* Conduct structured tests comparing prompts, tools, models, or workflow approaches
* Produce accurate written analysis, Excel-based support, and professional PowerPoint output
* Organize prompts, workflows, evaluation results, and guidance in Notion or another knowledge platform
* Support an initial use case involving SharePoint, Microsoft 365, or Power Platform
* Contribute effectively to consulting workstreams and client deliverables
* Incorporate feedback from senior team members and continuously improve the solution
* Demonstrate measurable improvements in efficiency, consistency, or output quality

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate:
  
  

* Uses AI tools regularly and enjoys experimenting with them
* Likes adjusting prompts, instructions, and workflows until the output improves
* Can perform the underlying analysis rather than relying entirely on AI
* Understands the difference between polished language and meaningful insight
* Produces organized, accurate, and professional work
* Is comfortable working across documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and knowledge systems
* Enjoys building reusable solutions rather than repeating manual tasks
* Can accept feedback, improve quickly, and operate with limited direction
* Is reliable, detail-oriented, and able to support a global consulting team
* Is curious about tools, models, integrations, and emerging capabilities

**What This Role Is Not**
This role is not primarily focused on:
  
  

* Building machine-learning models
* Conducting academic AI research
* Traditional software engineering
* Creating AI strategy presentations without hands-on execution
* Writing prompts without evaluating the underlying analysis
* Producing PowerPoint slides without understanding the content
* Testing new tools without turning them into repeatable processes

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
  
  
**How You Can Grow:**
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
  
  
**More about Crowe:**
Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
  
  
Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.
  
  
We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) – Mechanical
description:
**Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) – Mechanical**

Kalpakaaru Projects Pvt Ltd

Greater Noida

**Company Overview:**

Kalpakaaru Projects Pvt Ltd is a leading
**retail fixture and furniture manufacturing company**
based in
**Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh**
. We specialize in designing, engineering, and manufacturing high-quality, customized retail display fixtures, commercial furniture, and store environment solutions for premium global and domestic brands.

Job Summary

As a
**Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET)**
, you will undergo a structured training program across various core departments, including
**Design, Production, Quality Assurance, Key Account Management and Project Estimation**
. You will apply your foundational mechanical engineering knowledge to understand sheet metal fabrication, wood/mDF processing, powder coating, and assembly line operations to help deliver world-class retail fixtures.

Core Responsibilities

**1. Product Design & Engineering Support**

* **Technical Drawings:**
  Assist the design team in creating detailed 2D manufacturing drawings and 3D models using CAD software.
* **BOM Generation:**
  Create and maintain accurate Bill of Materials (BOM) for fixtures, detailing hardware, glass, plastic, wood, and metal parts.
* **Value Engineering:**
  Learn to optimize designs to reduce material waste and manufacturing costs while maintaining structural integrity.

**2. Production & Operations Management**

* **Process Planning:**
  Assist in drafting production routings and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for the shop floor.
* **Floor Coordination:**
  Monitor daily production schedules across sheet metal, CNC machining, carpentry, and powder coating departments.
* **Efficiency Tracking:**
  Track cycle times, identify production bottlenecks, and support the implementation of Lean manufacturing principles.



**3. Quality Control & Assurance**

* **Inspection:**
  Conduct in-process and final inspection of fixtures to ensure compliance with client specifications, dimensional tolerances, and aesthetic finishes.
* **Defect Analysis:**
  Identify root causes of manufacturing defects and suggest corrective/preventive actions (CAPA).

**4. Project Coordination & Estimation**

* **Material Costing:**
  Help estimate material quantities and processing costs for new retail fit-out inquiries.
* **Timeline Tracking:**
  Coordinate with procurement and logistics teams to ensure raw materials are available and finished fixtures are dispatched on time.

**Key Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Education:**
  **B.Tech / B.E. in Mechanical Engineering**
  or Production/Industrial Engineering.
* **Batch:**
  Recent graduate (2025/2026 passing out).
* **Software Skills:**
  Basic proficiency in
  **AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or Creo**
  is highly desirable.
* **Technical Knowledge:**
  Strong understanding of engineering drawing interpretation, GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing), and basic manufacturing processes (cutting, bending, welding).
* **Soft Skills:**
  Excellent problem-solving skills, strong communication, adaptability, and eagerness to work in a fast-paced factory environment.
* **Location:**
  Must be willing to work on-site at our manufacturing facility in
  **Greater Noida**
  .

What We Offer

* **Stipend/CTC:**
  Competitive industry standards for GETs
* **Career Growth:**
  Direct transition into roles like Design Engineer, Production Engineer, Key Account Manager or Quality Engineer after 1 year.
* **Hands-on Experience:**
  Exposure to end-to-end manufacturing from raw material to final premium retail store setups.

Kalpakaaru Projects Pvt Ltd is an equal opportunity employer.

Send in your resume to bobby.koothur@kalpakaaru.in

www.kalpakaaru.in

title: AI Safety Research & Policy Professional
description:
**Role Summary**

The AI Safety Research & Policy Professional will contribute to research, analysis, and knowledge development across emerging AI safety and security issues. The role will involve tracking global AI safety research, evaluation methodologies, standards, policy developments, and emerging risks, and translating these developments into clear, evidence-based insights and practical guidance.

The Professional will work closely with the technical AI safety research and testing function to analyse evaluation findings, identify emerging risk patterns, and connect empirical results with broader AI safety research and frameworks. The role will contribute to research publications, landscape assessments, readiness frameworks, briefings, and other outputs for industry and research partners.

This is a research-focused role requiring strong analytical, writing, and communication skills, along with a good understanding of AI/ML systems and emerging AI safety and security risks. The role is focused on applied AI safety research and knowledge development.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Safety Research & Landscape Analysis**

* Conduct structured research on emerging AI safety and security risks and developments.
* Track research papers, technical reports, evaluation studies, standards, frameworks, and publications from AI Safety Institutes, research organisations, evaluation labs, standards bodies, and other relevant institutions.
* Monitor developments in AI safety evaluation, assurance, testing, governance, and risk-management approaches.
* Track major developments in frontier and open-weight AI models and assess their potential AI safety and security implications.
* Maintain an organised knowledge base covering relevant AI safety research, frameworks, standards, methodologies, and developments.
* Identify emerging areas of AI safety research that may require further investigation, evaluation, or testing.
* Conduct comparative analysis of international approaches to AI safety and security, with particular attention to developments relevant to India.

**Research & Publications**

* Prepare research briefs, landscape reports, background papers, technical summaries, and other analytical outputs on AI safety and security topics.
* Review and synthesise technical research papers, evaluation reports, standards, frameworks, and other credible sources.
* Translate complex technical research into clear and accessible analysis for industry, research, and other non-specialist audiences.
* Contribute to periodic AI safety and security landscape assessments.
* Develop evidence-based insights and recommendations based on research findings and available evidence.
* Support the preparation of presentations, briefing materials, articles, reports, and other knowledge products.
* Identify gaps, limitations, and areas of uncertainty within existing AI safety research and evaluation approaches.

**AI Safety Frameworks, Standards & Readiness**

* Research and analyse AI safety frameworks, standards, evaluation methodologies, and assurance approaches developed by relevant international and national organisations.
* Assess the applicability of existing frameworks and approaches to organisations developing, deploying, or adopting AI systems.
* Contribute to the development of practical AI safety readiness frameworks, assessment approaches, checklists, and guidance.
* Support AI safety and security gap assessments based on established frameworks, standards, and available evidence.
* Translate research findings into practical recommendations for AI risk identification, evaluation, monitoring, and management.
* Monitor relevant developments in Indian AI governance, standards, and regulatory frameworks and assess their implications for AI safety practices.

**Collaboration with AI Safety Testing & Evaluation**

* Work closely with the AI Safety Research & Testing Professional to interpret technical evaluation findings.
* Analyse testing results in the context of existing AI safety research, frameworks, and standards.
* Identify recurring failure modes, emerging risks, and research questions based on empirical testing.
* Contribute to documenting and communicating findings from AI model and product evaluations.
* Help identify areas where additional testing or research may be required.
* Support the development of research outputs that combine empirical evaluation results with broader AI safety evidence.

**Knowledge Sharing & External Engagement**

* Contribute to workshops, briefings, roundtables, and knowledge-sharing activities on AI safety and security.
* Support engagement with industry, research, and other relevant partners.
* Present research findings and analysis to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Represent the initiative at relevant conferences, working groups, and technical or policy discussions, as appropriate.
* Build and maintain awareness of the wider AI safety research ecosystem and relevant organisations.
* Support the development of educational and awareness materials related to AI safety and security.

**Required Qualifications**

* 2-3 years of relevant experience in AI/ML research, AI safety, technology policy, AI governance, cybersecurity, technology risk, responsible AI, research, or a closely related field.
* Strong research and analytical capabilities, with demonstrated ability to identify, assess, and synthesise information from multiple sources.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, structured, and evidence-based research outputs.
* Working understanding of modern AI/ML systems, including large language models, foundation models, fine-tuning, RAG, and agentic AI systems.
* Good conceptual understanding of AI safety and security risks and emerging AI evaluation approaches.
* Ability to read and understand technical AI research papers, evaluation reports, and related documentation.
* Ability to distinguish established evidence from emerging research, assumptions, and areas of uncertainty.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to evidence-based analysis.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Public Policy, Technology Policy, or a related discipline. A Master's degree or relevant research experience is a strong plus.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Familiarity with AI safety research, AI evaluations, alignment, interpretability, robustness, AI assurance, or related areas.
* Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, standards, and emerging regulatory developments.
* Experience researching AI safety, cybersecurity, technology risks, or responsible AI.
* Familiarity with research and publications from AI Safety Institutes, evaluation labs, standards organisations, or leading AI research organisations.
* Experience producing research reports, policy briefs, technical papers, landscape assessments, or similar analytical outputs.
* Experience working with AI governance, responsible AI, technology risk, assurance, or compliance programmes.
* Basic technical skills in Python, data analysis, or AI evaluation are an advantage but are not essential.
* Public research, writing, or open-source contributions related to AI, AI safety, cybersecurity, or technology policy are a plus.
* Participation in AI safety programmes, fellowships, research groups, or relevant professional communities is a plus.

description:

This role focuses on crafting compelling, conversion-driven copy for landing pages, website pages, blogs, and other digital assets that communicate AAFT’s value proposition to prospective students and partners.

Experience & Skills

* Basic understanding of UX principles and user-centric content design.

**Industrial Technical Visual Reasoning Specialist (Subject Matter Expert) \- Engineering** 




  





**Job Overview** 




 We are seeking experienced engineers, technical professionals, simulation specialists, and domain experts to develop high\-quality multimodal reasoning benchmarks based on authentic industrial and engineering artifacts. The experts will create realistic, professional\-grade visual reasoning problems that evaluate advanced structural, spatial, functional, and analytical reasoning skills. Contributors will leverage real\-world technical documentation, drawings, schematics, layouts, and engineering artifacts to create benchmark tasks that can only be solved through careful visual interpretation and domain expertise. The benchmark spans multiple engineering and industrial disciplines and is intended to assess the reasoning capabilities of advanced AI systems on realistic professional workflows.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Benchmark Content Development
 



 • Create complex visual reasoning problems based on authentic industrial and engineering artifacts.
 



 • Develop tasks that require multi\-step reasoning, analysis, troubleshooting, design interpretation, planning, or decision\-making.
 



 • Ensure that the visual artifact is essential to solving the problem and that the task cannot be answered from text alone.
 



 • Design questions that emphasize structural, spatial, functional, and systems\-level reasoning rather than simple visual lookup or OCR. Problem/Solution Authoring For each benchmark item, create:
 



 1\. Problem Statement o A clear and unambiguous description of the task.
 



 2\. Visual Artifact o An authentic engineering or industrial artifact such as a CAD drawing, schematic, blueprint, floor plan, P\&ID, assembly diagram, process flow diagram, network topology, plant layout, or system diagram.
 



 3\. Final Answer o A concise, objective, and verifiable answer.
 



 4\. Worked Solution o A detailed step\-by\-step reasoning process demonstrating how the answer is derived from the visual artifact. Domains of Interest Experts with experience in one or more of the following domains are encouraged to apply:
 



  





 •
 **Mechanical Engineering** 




**• Electrical Engineering** 




**• Semiconductor Engineering** 




**• Process Engineering** 




**• Civil Engineering \& Architecture** 




**• Manufacturing Engineering** 




**• Robotics \& Automation** 




**• Utilities \& Power Systems** 




**• Aerospace Engineering** 




**• Telecommunications** 




**• Chemical Engineering** 




**• Material Science** 




**• Industrial Engineering** 




  





**Required Qualifications Education** 




 • Master's, or PhD in Engineering, Technology, Applied Sciences, Architecture, or a related discipline.
 



 Professional Experience Candidates should possess either:
 



 • 0\-3 years of relevant industry experience in engineering, design, operations, maintenance, manufacturing, planning, inspection, or system development;
 



 • 0\-3 years of professional experience in engineering simulation, modeling, digital twins, computer aided engineering (CAE), verification, validation, or system design involving the interpretation of real\-world technical artifacts.
 



  





**Technical Expertise** 




 • Strong understanding of engineering documentation and professional technical artifacts.
 



 • Ability to interpret complex diagrams, drawings, schematics, layouts, and system representations. • Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Excellent technical writing and communication skills.
 



 • Ability to explain engineering reasoning in a structured and detailed manner.

title: US Proposal Specialist / Proposal Writer
description:
**US PROPOSAL SPECIALIST** 




  





 Acro Service Corporation, Bid and Proposal Team
 



  





**Experience: 3\+** 
 Years
 



**Shift:** 
**Night Shift (7:30 PM \-4:30 AM IST)** 




**Location:** 
 Noida Sector 68 (Onsite)
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Acro Service Corporation (Acro) is seeking an experienced Proposal Specialist to join its Bid and Proposal team, supporting Acro's US staffing, MSP, VMS, and workforce solutions business from India. The Proposal Specialist is a hands\-on individual contributor and full member of the proposal team, responsible for managing assigned Complex and Express RFx opportunities from initial review through final submission. This is a fast paced, high ownership role covering the full response lifecycle, from initial solicitation assessment and Go No Go input through response planning, strategy sessions, content development, reviews, and final compliance and submission.
 



 Complex RFx are large, formal solicitations, typically from state and local governments and large commercial buyers, that require a full response plan, strategy sessions, and multiple contributors. Express bids are smaller, quick turn solicitations that one person can typically assess, assemble, and submit within a few days.
 



 The role calls for strong project management, judgment, and follow through: anticipating what is needed next, following up independently with contributors, and moving assigned responses forward without continuous direction, while working within Acro's proposal SOPs and escalating when a leadership decision is required. Solicitations carry strict compliance and submission requirements, and a single missed instruction can disqualify a bid, so close reading and attention to detail are essential.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



1. **Manage assigned Complex and Express RFx responses from beginning to end.** 
 Review the solicitation, build the compliance checklist and response plan, coordinate meetings and inputs, develop the response from approved Acro content tailored to the issuer's requirements, and drive it through final submission.
2. **Contribute to Go No Go and response strategy.** 
 Conduct the initial opportunity review, facilitate assigned strategy discussions, and recommend relevant Acro capabilities, experience, and proof points.
3. **Apply proposal and workforce solutions expertise.** 
 Build working knowledge of Acro's staffing, MSP, VMS, RPO, technical and consulting, and related services; use standard content only where it actually answers the requirement; and escalate pricing, contractual, legal, or significant solution decisions to the appropriate owner.
4. **Project manage assigned responses within the proposal SOP.** 
 Own timelines, dependencies, reviews, and approvals; anticipate bottlenecks; and apply the team's checklists, templates, and quality controls consistently.
5. **Manage proposal meetings and SME contributions.** 
 Facilitate kickoff, strategy, working, and review sessions, and obtain complete input from leadership, business development, operations, finance, legal, and subject matter experts, following up persistently until it is received.
6. **Develop, tailor, and integrate proposal content.** 
 Draft and edit clear, accurate, persuasive content aligned to the evaluation criteria, and integrate input from multiple contributors into one consistent response.
7. **Ensure compliance, quality, and submission readiness.** 
 Track every mandatory requirement, form, and submission instruction, and conduct thorough final compliance and quality reviews before submission.
8. **Track and interpret solicitation changes.** 
 Monitor amendments, addenda, and Q\&A, summarize their impact, and update the response accordingly.
9. **Maintain proposal content, references, and document control.** 
 Keep proposal content, templates, references, and past performance current, and maintain SharePoint organization, version control, and RFx Tracker status for assigned bids.
10. **Support continuous improvement and team priorities.** 
 Recommend practical process and content improvements, contribute to business development collateral, and collaborate on other team responses during peak periods.



  





**Requirements** 








* Demonstrated experience managing bids or proposals from solicitation review through content coordination, compliance, production, approvals, and final submission.
* Ability to manage both quick turn and complex responses with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and shifting deadlines.
* Experience facilitating proposal kickoff, strategy, and review meetings and converting decisions into actions and content.
* Strong critical thinking and judgment, with the ability to interpret requirements and evaluation criteria, identify gaps and risks, and recommend practical next steps.
* Excellent written English with strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills, and the ability to adapt tone and level of detail to different buyers.
* Demonstrated attention to detail, including experience with compliance matrices and formal submission requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to obtain information from busy subject matter experts and drive accountability respectfully.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, including styles, tables, and templates, and working proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
* Ability to work U.S. Eastern business hours and communicate clearly and promptly with U.S. based colleagues.
* Familiarity with U.S. government procurement portals, SAM.gov, and cooperative contracts is strongly preferred.

 The role will work closely with site leadership, production planners, manufacturing operations teams, and global product teams to ensure successful adoption of standardized planning processes across EMEA and India.
 



  
 



**As our Ortems Functional Analyst, you will be responsible for:** 




  
 


* Bring proven experience across multiple DELMIA Ortems implementations as a Functional Analyst in Advanced Planning \& Scheduling (APS)

* Work closely with production planners, schedulers, plant leadership teams, and business stakeholders

* Configure scheduling parameters, planning models, calendars, resources, and constraints within Ortems
* Participate in solution design workshops and deployment planning sessions
* Conduct user training and support change management activities during implementation projects
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), business validation, and go\-live readiness assessments
* Assist sites during hypercare and post\-go\-live stabilization activities
* Support issue investigation and functional troubleshooting activities
* Collaborate with ERP, MES, and integration teams to ensure end\-to\-end planning process alignment
* Maintain business process documentation, training materials, work instructions, and deployment artifacts
* Support release testing and validation activities
* Promote standard planning processes and best practices across EMEA and India sites
* Identify continuous improvement opportunities within planning and scheduling processes
* Support master data design and governance relevant to planning, including resources, calendars, routings, and planning constraints
* Provide functional guidance and best practices to business users throughout the project lifecycle
* Support global template adoption while addressing local site requirements where necessary
* Travel to manufacturing sites as required to support workshops, deployments, training, go\-live activities, and stabilization efforts



  
 



**Functional Skills** 








* Hands\-on experience with DELMIA Ortems APS solutions
* Strong understanding of:
* Production Scheduling
* Capacity Planning
* Finite Scheduling
* Sequencing
* Resource Allocation
* Constraint Management
* What\-if Simulations
* Good understanding of manufacturing operations and discrete manufacturing environments
* Experience working with ERP systems, preferably SAP
* Experience supporting manufacturing system deployments and rollouts
* Strong workshop facilitation and stakeholder management skills
* Experience creating training materials and delivering end\-user training
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities
* Experience supporting go\-live and hypercare activities
* Working knowledge of Agile project methodologies
* Knowledge of MES processes and manufacturing execution systems is an advantage
* Experience working in global and multi\-site manufacturing environments
* Ability to communicate effectively with business stakeholders, planners, operational teams, and IT teams



  
 



**Experience** 








* 5\+ years of Manufacturing IT, Production Planning, Supply Chain Planning, or APS experience
* 3\+ years of hands\-on DELMIA Ortems functional experience
* Proven experience supporting APS implementations and manufacturing site deployments
* Experience working directly with production planners, schedulers, and plant operations teams
* Experience supporting multi\-site and international manufacturing environments preferred
* Experience supporting manufacturing transformation initiatives and business process improvements is an advantage



  
 



**Preferred Background** 









 Candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas are highly desirable:
 


* DELMIA Ortems APS
* Production Planning
* Supply Chain Planning
* Manufacturing Operations
* SAP PP / PP\-DS
* MES\-integrated planning environments
* Discrete Manufacturing
* Global Manufacturing Deployments

description:

 We are a US\-based technology advisory team that runs IT integration for private equity acquisitions \- standing up network, security, identity, applications, and connectivity for newly acquired companies. We are looking for an Integration Support Coordinator based in India to work alongside us as a true team member.
   

  

 This role turns call transcripts, notes, and open action items into clean trackers, decks, and follow\-ups. Time zone overlap with the US team is limited, so you will work mostly from recordings and written context rather than live calls \- and you will be trusted to keep the plan moving without needing to be on every call.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role \- we need someone who catches issues early, keeps every workstream up to date, and makes sure open action items get closed.
   

  

 What You Will Own
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Integration Plan and Workstream Tracking**
* Maintain the master integration tracker across workstreams (network, cybersecurity, identity/devices, applications/email, connectivity, procurement)
* Update workstream status, dates, and owners after each call
* Track budget vs. actual hours by workstream and flag variances


**Call Follow\-Up and Action Items**
* Review call transcripts and recordings, extract action items, owners, and deadlines
* Log action items in the tracker and escalate stale ones
* Draft follow\-up emails and status recaps from template


**Deliverable and Deck Support**
* Build and update integration status slides for client and internal steering committee updates
* Assemble Day 1 and Day 100 plans, cutover checklists, and workstream trackers
* Maintain version control across decks for concurrent deals


**Program Management Support**
* Support running the same integration playbook across multiple concurrent acquisitions
* Track due diligence pipeline status for deals not yet in active integration
* Maintain the Context Index and file organization for integration artifacts


 What Great Looks Like:
   

  

* Turns transcripts and notes into accurate deliverables, no live call context needed
* Keeps trackers and decks current across every active deal \- no stale data
* Flags variances, blockers, and stale action items before they become problems
* Learns the playbook well enough to run it cleanly across multiple deals at once
* Communicates clearly and flags blockers or delays as soon as they come up


 What You Bring:
   

  

* 2\+ years in project/program coordination, PMO, or consulting support role \- ideally at a consulting, advisory, or professional services firm
* Comfort working from meeting transcripts and written notes rather than live call attendance
* Strong PowerPoint skills
* Comfort building and maintaining trackers, dashboards, and structured data views
* Excellent written English \- you'll be drafting emails and updates that go straight to clients
* Strong attention to detail and a low tolerance for stale or broken data
* Comfortable working independently on recurring tasks without much oversight
* Some overlap with US Eastern or Central time is preferred but not required
* Bonus: background in M\&A, IT integration, or program management


 Tools You Will Use
   

  

 Notion, SharePoint, Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel), call transcript tools (Fireflies or similar), AI (Copilot, Claude, etc.) and internal communication tools. You do not need to be an expert in all of these on day one, but you should be able to come up to speed quickly.
   

  

 We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
   

  

**Our Benefits:**
 At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
   

  

**How You Can Grow:**
 We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
   

  

**More about Crowe:**
 Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
   

  

 Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

description:
**Programme Associate \- Industrial Heat Decarbonisation** 




  





 The International Forum for Environment, Sustainability \& Technology (iFOREST), is looking for an experienced and dynamic professional to support \& lead the organisation’s research initiatives and policy engagement in the Industrial transition and decarbonization.
 



 A successful applicant must have a proven aptitude for analytical research and multi\-stakeholder engagement, and excellent communication skills with government, industry and related agencies. The candidate should ideally have sound
 **technical and policy knowledge and experience knowledge of working in Energy Efficiency, Energy management, Boiler\-based industries, and MSME sectors such as\- Food \& beverages, Textile, Chemicals, Pharma etc. Overall knowledge of industrial decarbonization is desirable.** 




  





**Location** 
 : Sector 132, Noida, India
 



**Required Experience** 
 : 5\+ years
 



  





***About iFOREST***




 iFOREST is an independent not\-for\-profit research and innovation organisation that was established in 2019 to identify, promote and scale up solutions for pressing environment\-development challenges in India and other developing countries in Asia and Africa.
 



 Our work is rooted in regional priorities to accelerate environmental actions at the sub\-national level and to improve national policies and plans to support it. Our mission is to address the unique needs of regions by leveraging our resources and expertise to scale up national action and make a global impact. We use our regional knowledge to inform national policy and plans and strengthen international collaboration.
 



 To achieve our goals, we conduct independent evidence\-based research, develop new knowledge and innovative solutions, convene stakeholders to increase awareness and build consensus, and partner with think tanks, civil society, government agencies, philanthropies and industry to scale up solutions.
 



***The Industrial Decarbonization Programmme***




 The Industrial Decarbonization Programme is a part of iFOREST’s flagship initiative on Enabling Energy Transitions. The objective of the programme is to steer a green industry transition to support green growth and green jobs, while improving local environmental conditions and achieving climate goals. The focus is on conducing evidence\-based research, including modelling studies to develop comprehensive roadmaps, identify policy solutions and provide technical support for industrial decarbonisation in sectors like steel, fertilizer, cement, bricks and at\-risk MSME sectors, as a transition in these sectors will affect the largest number of consumers and enterprises.
 



 The Programme is strongly focused on technical research and stakeholder engagement (especially with government departments/agencies and the industry) to achieve a green transition of fossil fuel\-dependent factories that are associated with various industries.
 



***The Role***




 The Programme Associate will be responsible for the execution of research and engagement outputs pertaining to industrial decarbonisation across boiler based industries and MSME sector. This would entail conducting impactful research and multi\-stakeholder engagement, with the support of a dedicated team. In addition, they would also be expected to identify new areas of work to support institutional goals.
 



  





 Specific tasks to be undertaken are:
 



**Support and execute the research initiatives of the Programme.** 



* Contribute to designing research assignments, including developing research strategy and methodology as well as identifying specific activities and tasks.
* Conduct in\-depth primary and secondary research including quantitative and qualitative assessments.
* Remain updated with the latest tools and techniques for executing qualitative and quantitative research.
* Write research documents, including analytical reports and policy papers based on evidence.
* Mentor young researchers in in the team in executing research assignments.
* Stay abreast with the latest developments and debates in the sector.

* Design and manage a comprehensive outreach strategy for the programme as well as for projects therein.
