* Build and leverage relationships to design and conduct roundtables, convenings, and report release meetings with government, industry, civil society, media, etc.



  





**Additional duties** 



* Contribute to shaping the overall strategy for the programme, aligned with institutional priorities, sector\-specific issues and ongoing work of other key institutions.
* Identify new pathways, initiatives, and partnerships that contribute to programmatic goals.
* Support development of new concept notes, proposals, theory of change and budgets for projects/interventions that further institutional objectives.
* Contribute to the institution’s brand building by representing iFOREST on various public platforms.
* Execute any related assignments that may arise in relation to the tasks or for further enhancement of the programme.



  





***Qualification \& Work Experience***



* A Bachelors or
 **Master's in engineering is a must, preferably in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Energy System, and Environmental or related streams.**
* The candidate must have experience of research and work on
 **Energy efficiency; Energy Management; Boiler\-based industries and efficiency of MSME sectors, such as\- Food and Beverages, Textile, Chemicals, Pharma, etc.**
* Knowledge of industrial decarbonization strategies is also a must.

 **minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience**

title: Writer Intern
description:
**About the Role:** 




 We’re looking for a strong writer with excellent English, sharp research skills, and an eye for storytelling to join our application team.
 



 As an Admissions Content Intern, you’ll work on real student applications and help transform their academic experiences, achievements, and aspirations into compelling application narratives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Draft, edit, and refine SOPs, LORs, personal statements, university essays, and resumes/CVs under senior writer/editor guidance.
* Understand student profiles and identify their strongest stories, experiences, and differentiators.
* Convert student inputs, questionnaires, and meeting notes into clear and compelling narratives.
* Conduct university\- and program\-specific research to tailor application documents.
* Strengthen documents for structure, narrative flow, clarity, grammar, tone, and authenticity.
* Ensure documents are personalized, credible, and free from generic or AI\-sounding language.
* Incorporate feedback across multiple rounds of revisions while maintaining accuracy and consistency.
* Work closely with senior writers and counselors to develop the student’s overall application narrative and positioning.
* Manage multiple student documents and deadlines simultaneously.



  





**What We're Looking For:** 



* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Strong storytelling skills and the ability to write with clarity and personality.
* Excellent research and reading\-comprehension skills.
* Strong command of grammar and attention to detail.
* Ability to understand a person’s experiences and turn them into meaningful stories.
* Comfortable receiving feedback and rewriting extensively.
* Prior experience with SOPs, essays, resumes, college applications, or long\-form writing is a plus.
* Students/recent graduates from English, Journalism, Literature, Liberal Arts, Communications, Psychology, Management, or related fields are welcome.



  





**What You'll Gain:** 



* Internship Completion Certificate
* Exposure to top global universities including Oxford, Cambridge, Ivy League, LSE, Imperial, and more
* Hands\-on experience with SOPs, LORs, essays, and resumes rather than generic content writing
* PPO / Full\-Time Opportunity based on performance
* Performance recognition for exceptional work



  





**Internship Details:** 




**Duration:** 
 3 Months
 



**Location:** 
 On\-site — World Trade Tower, Sector 16, Noida
 



**Stipend:** 
 ₹10,000–₹14,000/month, depending on writing ability, experience, and overall profile.
 



  





**About Intelligent Education:** 




 Intelligent Education is a premium study abroad consulting firm helping ambitious students gain admission to leading universities globally. Our application team works closely with students to develop compelling, authentic, and strategically positioned application documents.
 



  





**Join Us:** 




 If you’re someone who loves writing, research, storytelling, and understanding people, this is an opportunity to build real expertise in international university applications, admissions writing, and student storytelling.
 



 Apply now to join Intelligent Education.

title: Associate I - Bids and Proposals (P04664)
description:
**Position Overview**
 The
 **Lead – Bids \& Proposals** 
 is responsible for managing the complete bid lifecycle—from opportunity identification and qualification through proposal development, submission, and post‑submission follow‑ups. This role ensures high‑quality, compelling, and compliant proposals that maximize win potential. The Lead partners closely with Sales, Pre‑Sales, Delivery, Finance, Legal, and Senior Leadership to drive strategic, timely, and commercially strong responses to RFPs/RFIs/RFQs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Bid Management \& Strategy
* Lead end‑to‑end bid management across all stages: initiation, planning, content development, review, submission, and handover.
* Assess bid requirements and develop clear win strategies, themes, and value propositions.
* Facilitate bid/no‑bid decisions by evaluating strategic fit, risks, and resource requirements.
* Create bid plans, schedules, and resource assignments, ensuring on‑time delivery.
* Proposal Development
* Write, structure, and edit proposal content to ensure clarity, quality, accuracy, and persuasiveness.
* Coordinate inputs from technical, commercial, and operational teams to produce cohesive proposals.
* Ensure proposals comply with all customer requirements and internal governance standards.
* Develop standardized templates, boilerplates, and content libraries for efficiency and consistency.
* Stakeholder Coordination
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams—Sales, Solutions, Delivery, Finance, Legal, HR, Risk—to gather content and approvals.
* Conduct proposal reviews and steer strategic improvements.
* Serve as the single point of contact for all proposal‑related communication with internal teams.
* Commercial \& Risk Management
* Support pricing teams by providing inputs on assumptions, scope, and deliverables.
* Identify risks and mitigation strategies, ensuring commercial soundness.
* Validate adherence to contractual, financial, and legal guidelines.
* Quality Assurance \& Continuous Improvement
* Maintain high standards of proposal quality, formatting, messaging, and compliance.
* Analyze bid outcomes and conduct post‑mortem reviews to refine future processes.
* Manage and update knowledge bases, case studies, and proposal archives.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
**Education \& Experience**
* Thorough understanding of procurement \& tendering processes of Capital \& Revenue procurement of MoD.
* Min 4 years of experience in bid management, proposals, pre‑sales, or business development in defence \& aerospace sector.
* Proven track record of leading complex, multi‑million\-dollar bids of MoD


**Technical \& Professional Skills**
* Strong understanding of RFP/RFI/RFQ processes and proposal frameworks.
* Exceptional writing, communication, and storytelling abilities.
* Ability to interpret technical solutions and articulate them in business language.
* Proficiency in CRM, MS Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel) and proposal automation tools.
* Strong project management and organizational skills with attention to detail.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Strategic thinking and ability to influence diverse stakeholders.
* High ownership, accountability, and ability to work under tight deadlines.
* Collaborative, proactive, and solution\-oriented mindset.

title: Senior Engagement Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
 WSP has an exciting opportunity for an enthusiastic and motivated individual to join our growing Engagement \& Consultation team. We drive best practice in engagement, community relations, consultation and stakeholder management in the delivery of some of the UK’s largest infrastructure projects as well as delivering expertise within the water, health, energy and environmental sectors. Within our Instructure Planning and Environmental Assessment business unit, you will manage public consultation and engagement activity, work at different stages of the consenting process from early feasibility, application preparation and delivery of consents through construction, and act as a trusted advisor for clients. You will also be responsible for working collaboratively with colleagues across WSP to deliver engaging communications.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Delivering meaningful communication and engagement activity to help our clients deliver infrastructure projects around the UK by drafting and delivering effective stakeholder engagement strategies
* Supporting clients by planning and delivering engagement and consultation activities,

* Working in conjunction with multi\-disciplinary teams to translate technical information into plain English
* Helping to prepare Town \& Country Planning Act applications for infrastructure projects across the UK, and preparing consenting inputs on major infrastructure projects
* Providing technical advice to clients and support managing their consenting requirements
* Presenting feedback to inform decision making by understanding and interpreting data, and managing the reporting process to present key themes clearly.
* Managing projects, including ensuring that resources are in place to deliver on time and to budget.
